subject: website
name: Assertions
summary: Docs and builder for on-chain assertions (ERC-8211), source public in BlossomLabs/Assertions (MIT, website folder). It runs no third-party code at load; its support widget posts only when a message is sent. It is not Level 4: it loads Google Fonts when it opens, and the builder asks api.evmcrispr.com for token lists.
